findings.title: Lane schema omits uniqueness constraint
findings.why_it_matters: The advertised MCP schema accepts duplicate flowNodeIds, while the runtime validator rejects them. Schema-driven clients can therefore construct a request that passes the advertised contract but receives an Invalid arguments error at execution time.
findings.suggested_fix: Ensure the generated add_lane inputSchema includes flowNodeIds.uniqueItems: true (while retaining the Zod runtime refinement), and assert that advertised constraint in the request-validation test.
evidence: src/server/tools.ts:224-227 enforces uniqueness with a Zod refine over flowNodeIds.

The generated add_lane inputSchema contains type: array and minItems: 1 but no uniqueItems keyword; parseToolRequest('add_lane', { poolId: 'p', name: 'n', flowNodeIds: ['a', 'a'] }) throws 'Flow node IDs must be unique'.

testing_gaps: The request-validation suite checks runtime rejection of malformed arguments but does not assert that add_lane's advertised flowNodeIds schema declares uniqueness.
